subject: RP10 design: W2.a and W2.d are below coverage threshold
body:
GR — ran concept-coverage analysis across all 9 practice exams. Two standards are below the 5-slot threshold:

- W2.a: 4 slots total, only in RP8 and RP9. No coverage in RP1-7.
- W2.d: 3 slots total, only in RP7, RP8, RP9. No coverage in RP1-6.

For RP10, I recommend:
- W2.a: 2+ questions (one per section A slot is standard)
- W2.d: 2+ questions to bring it to 5+ total

All other standards are well-covered:
- W2.b: 24 slots (9 exams) — might be able to reduce slightly
- W3.b: 30 slots (9 exams) — dominant
- W3.d: 22 slots (9 exams) — strong

Script to re-run: node scripts/concept-coverage.cjs
Threshold can be overridden: MCM_COVERAGE_THRESHOLD=7 node scripts/concept-coverage.cjs

This is for RP10 planning — no action needed on existing exams.
